purpose: Identity of the inherited upstream GNN baseline: the fixed upstream files, their expected sizes and SHA-256 values, the expected documentation metadata and the canonical run's expected reported values. Read by ehr_evidence_app.gnn.baseline; nothing upstream is executed.

metrics.note: reported_test_values labels are descriptive, not metrics.json key names; each value must appear among the top-level numeric entries of the reported test object.

limitations: The upstream directory has no .git metadata, so no revision or working-tree state can be recorded and the tree is not claimed to be clean. The SHA-256 content hashes of the listed files are the reproducible baseline surrogate.
Only the listed files are identified. Other upstream files are not part of this baseline.
All metric values are those reported by the inherited run's metrics.json. The downstream project did not train, evaluate, run inference or compute attributions to obtain them.
The checkpoint, patient graphs, explanations and vocabularies are identified by filesystem metadata and SHA-256 only. They are not loaded, deserialised or validated as model or data objects.
diag_kg is identified as the OMOP + KG run only because its metrics.json reports data_source=omop and no_kg=false. Nothing further about graph construction or KG content is inferred.
Checks are made at one moment. A change between a check and a read is detected only as a size or modification-time change while a file is hashed.
